sources.traffic_flow: HERE Traffic API v7 /flow (speed, free-flow speed, jam factor, traversability)
sources.incidents: HERE Traffic API v7 /incidents (closures, accidents, construction, flooding reports)
sources.weather: Weatherstack current observations at one point per city

calibration_split.note: Declared before any live data was used. Development (7 days, every weekday and the weekend once) fits the hourly CRITIC weights, development maxima and Cheng references; tuning fixes q0, beta and the search time limit; test is held out for the comparison. October 31 to November 2 (Undas: All Saints' and All Souls' Days) is collected but excluded because holiday travel makes Metro Manila traffic atypical.

sampling.calibration: the first capture of every development hour (up to 168 hours); all 30,511 directed segments are the alternatives in each hour
sampling.tuning: 12 origin-destination pairs on random tuning-period captures
sampling.test: 30 origin-destination pairs on random test-period captures, 5 seeds each
